claim_text: HEX Series modular benchtop and research PVD platforms supporting sputtering and evaporation.
supporting_quote: The HEX Series is a modular PVD system designed for research and educational applications, supporting magnetron sputtering, electron beam evaporation, and thermal evaporation.
known_limitations: Modular components must be configured specifically for the target deposition technique (e.g. sputtering vs thermal boat).
Vacuum levels dependent on installed turbo-molecular pumping package.

claim_text: Thin-film and PVD training and remote customer support.
supporting_quote: Korvus Technology publishes teaching and training resources for thin-film research and provides direct customer support for HEX users.
known_limitations: On-site installation and field service require explicit regional quotation.
Customer support requires active warranty or service agreement.

claim_text: Spark-discharge synthesis systems for metallic and graphitic nanoparticles.
supporting_quote: ParteQ offers spark discharge generators and synthesis systems for the continuous generation of metallic, bimetallic, and carbon nanoparticles in gas phase.
known_limitations: Precursor rods and carrier gas purity determine particle size distribution and output rate.

claim_text: CVD-based powder functionalization and surface modification systems.
supporting_quote: Fluidized-bed and aerosol-assisted CVD systems for continuous coating and functionalization of micro- and nano-powders.
known_limitations: Limited to powder and particulate substrates; cannot be used for planar wafer CVD deposition.

claim_text: Atomic Absorption Spectrometers (AAS) and ICP-OES analytical instrumentation.
supporting_quote: PG Instruments supplies Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometers (flame and graphite furnace) and Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectrometers for analytical laboratories.
known_limitations: Consumable hollow cathode lamps and certified calibration standards required for target elements.

claim_text: Territory-specific distributor authorization and localized warranty support.
supporting_quote: Instruments are distributed through authorized territorial partners who provide commissioning and technical maintenance.
known_limitations: Distributor authorization letters are country- and tender-specific.
Historical authorization records for specific territories (e.g. Moldova) do not extend globally.

claim_text: Flow Battery Test Cells and PEM Electrolyzer Test Cells.
supporting_quote: Precision test fixtures including Flow Battery Test Cells and PEM Water Electrolysis single cells for electrochemical research and membrane characterization.
known_limitations: Fixtures designed for laboratory cell testing; not megawatt-scale industrial stack deployments.
Conductivity measurements require TIC-95 membrane test fixture.

claim_text: U-FAST Field-Assisted Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS/FAST) furnace systems.
supporting_quote: U-FAST advanced Spark Plasma Sintering equipment utilizing very short, high-density current pulses for rapid densification of nano-materials, ceramics, and intermetallics.
known_limitations: Requires high-power 3-phase electrical supply and chilled cooling water.
Graphite die tooling sizes determine maximum sample diameter.

claim_text: Broad Ion Beam Deposition (IBD) and Ion Beam Etching (IBE) processing systems.
supporting_quote: Nordiko designs and builds broad ion beam systems for spintronics, magnetic sensor fabrication, and optical thin film coatings.
known_limitations: Substrate diameter is bounded by model (e.g. N1500-600 accommodates up to 500 mm substrate diameter).
Process gases require calibrated MFC delivery.

claim_text: Direct thermal decomposition and cold vapor atomic absorption/fluorescence mercury analyzers.
supporting_quote: Nippon Instruments Corporation specializes exclusively in mercury measurement instrumentation, including direct thermal evaporation and reduction vaporization analyzers.
known_limitations: Instrumentation is strictly dedicated to mercury analysis; does not analyze general heavy metals (lead, cadmium, arsenic) without specialized digestion/detection.

claim_text: Mercury measurement in fertilizer raw materials, rock phosphate, and chemical processing.
supporting_quote: Determination of trace mercury in fertilizers, agricultural soils, and chemical raw materials compliant with international environmental standards.
known_limitations: Valid for mercury detection in fertilizer products; does not supply fertilizer commodities, urea, or bulk chemicals.

claim_text: Continuous wave and pulsed Electron Paramagnetic Resonance (EPR/ESR) spectrometers.
supporting_quote: SpinFlex manufactures benchtop and research-grade pulse and CW Electron Paramagnetic Resonance spectrometers covering X-band and Q-band frequencies.
known_limitations: Magnetic field swept electromagnet and microwave bridge required; cryogenic sample temperatures require liquid helium/nitrogen cryostat option.

claim_text: Industrial cathodic arc and magnetron sputtering PVD hard-coating systems.
supporting_quote: STATON produces industrial PVD coating equipment with cathodic vacuum arc and pulsed magnetron technology for cutting tools, forming tools, and wear parts.
known_limitations: Industrial coating chambers requiring rotary substrate carousel and multi-target arc evaporation configurations.

claim_text: Closed Field Unbalanced Magnetron Sputter Ion Plating (CFUBMSIP) systems.
supporting_quote: Teer Coatings patented Closed Field Unbalanced Magnetron Sputter Ion Plating systems provide high ion current density for dense, adherent coatings.
known_limitations: Optimized for tribological, optical, and biomedical coatings; does not manufacture semiconductor fab front-end wafer track systems.

claim_text: Spatial Atomic Layer Deposition (SALD) equipment operating at atmospheric pressure.
supporting_quote: SALD R&D tool enables spatial atomic layer deposition at atmospheric conditions with deposition rates orders of magnitude faster than conventional temporal ALD.
known_limitations: Substrate must be planar or flexible web; high-aspect-ratio trench step coverage requires specific precursor head clearance.

claim_text: Agilis Series MOCVD reactors for wide-bandgap semiconductors (Ga2O3, GaN, AlN).
claim_term: Agilis GOX300 Gallium Oxide MOCVD system
supporting_quote: Agnitron designs and manufactures specialized MOCVD reactors, including the Agilis GOX300 Gallium Oxide system equipped with a 305 mm wafer carrier.
known_limitations: Configured for 305 mm wafer carrier plate; production wafer count and throughput scale must be confirmed against customer specification.

claim_text: Ultra-high vacuum E-beam evaporators, MBE, and sputtering systems.
supporting_quote: AdNaNoTek provides customized high-vacuum thin-film deposition equipment including electron beam evaporators, magnetron sputtering, and molecular beam epitaxy.
known_limitations: Josephson Junction fabrication capability is specifically tied to the Quantum Computing Deposition System model.

claim_text: Large-substrate precision spin coaters and matrix spray coating systems.
supporting_quote: ON Nano supplies automated high-uniformity spin coating systems for large glass panels, semiconductor substrates, and advanced packaging.
known_limitations: Chamber dimensions restrict maximum substrate dimensions to model envelope (e.g. 300x300 mm).
